locations.note: Rosa and Joey follow the deaths connected to Lazarus Technologies through a film studio, an art gallery and the Meltzer Foundation.
Rosa meets the ghost Frank Lyons here, hears the bartender explain Joe Gould and the Gould fund, and returns later.
Rosa questions Marty Goldwater, whose son John was killed nearby and who suspects Lazarus Technologies.

routes.name: Rosa Blackwell
routes.note: From the Greenwich Village tavern to the lighthouse on Roosevelt Island.
